summary: Backend-only verification of dummy invoice cleanup for TRAYAMBAK GST Billing app. All 5 pytest assertions passed: (1) GET /api/invoices returns exactly 1 invoice with number TE/2026-27/0001, customer 'Chief Executive Officer', grand_total 52156 - no 'Preview Test Co' data present; (2) GET /api/customers returns []; (3) GET /api/users returns only hi@trayambak.in; (4) GET /api/reports/summary reflects only real invoice; (5) POST /api/invoices generated TE/2026-27/0002 confirming counter reset works atomically. After verification, the TE/2026-27/0002 test invoice was deleted and counter seq reset back to 1 via mongosh, so the user's ledger is clean and their next real invoice will be TE/2026-27/0002.
seed_data_creation: Created & then deleted verification invoice TE/2026-27/0002 (customer 'Verify Counter Co'); counter for FY 2026-27 reset back to seq=1 post-verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB state after this iteration: db.invoices has exactly one document (TE/2026-27/0001, Chief Executive Officer, grand_total 52156). db.counters has invoice_2026-27 seq=1. db.customers is empty. db.users contains only hi@trayambak.in. rca of the issue: Not a code bug - data-only cleanup. Dummy invoice TE/2026-27/0001 ('Preview Test Co') was created during a prior visual regression test. Main agent used mongosh to delete the dummy, rename the real invoice from 0002 to 0001, and reset the counter to seq=1 so next $inc via find_one_and_update yields 2. Verification confirmed all three actions succeeded and the atomic counter logic in next_invoice_number() correctly increments to 0002.
